messages:
lina_cs: Heads-up — MeadowBridge (3PL) wants to onboard a bespoke 'stock deviation' model. They care about minimizing false positives for fulfillment teams and are strict about EU data residency and contractor identifiers. They attached a data sample and a vendor model spec (closed-source 6B).

rex_se: Do they want hosted or private? Also any SLO asks?

lina_cs: They asked for Private deployment in eu-west-1, customer-managed keys, non-persistent storage of raw ids, and an SLA target: p50 <= 180ms, p95 <= 500ms, target throughput 150 rps.

anjali_ml: 6B should be fine on Dedicated with 4-bit quant, but we need the model format (pt/ggml/onnx) and info on KV cache usage. Can they provide a held-out labeled set with anomalies/normal events?

lina_cs: Vendor can share a validation CSV (~8k rows) but contractor_id and client_phone are present. MeadowBridge requests automated redaction for logs and a processing mask so we never persist raw contractor_id.

derek_ops: On infra: Private VPC in eu-west-1 + HSM is doable. We'll need a compliance review for data residency and to lock logging levels. For latency SLOs we recommend Dedicated with prewarmed endpoints (min replicas 2) and autoscale policy for spikes.

legalbot: New case created: CS-4891 MeadowBridge onboarding. Please attach DPA request and regional compliance checklist.

rex_se: For evaluation, propose these pass/fail gates: precision >= 0.88 on anomalies, recall >= 0.65, end-to-end p95 <= 500ms on 512-token sim, and no retention of raw identifier columns. Can we shadow their stream for 10 business days?

anjali_ml: Shadowing okay but need an allowlist for what fields can be logged. Also request a small stratified sample (at least 5k rows) covering EU and NA warehouses. We'll run:
```
- scripts: eval_stock_deviation.py --gold gold.csv --pred preds.csv --out metrics.json
- metrics: precision recall f1 latency_p50 latency_p95
```

lina_cs: MeadowBridge confirmed 8k labeled rows and agreed to mask contractor_id with reversible tokenization accessible only via HSM. They also asked about rollbacks in case of quality regressions.

derek_ops: We'll implement tokenization at ingest and enable key rotation in HSM. Rollback strategy: route traffic to a fallback smaller model (verified baseline) automatically if precision drops > 5% or latency spikes above SLO for 3 consecutive mins. Need product/legal signoff.

lina_cs: Action items: 1) legal to review and sign DPA + residency (lina to loop in legal) 2) ops to provision eu-west-1 private cluster + HSM (derek) 3) ml to verify artifact compatibility and run initial eval on vendor sample (anjali) 4) SE to coordinate shadowing schedule and canary (rex). Target: initial eval and compatibility check in 7 business days.

anjali_ml: I'll start compatibility tests today. If the vendor format is incompatible we'll ask for ONNX export or provide conversion guidance. Posting results in ~3 business days.

rex_se: Noting renewal risk: MeadowBridge is evaluating Dedicated vs hosted; they'll likely commit to reserved capacity if latency+precision are met. If we underdeliver on p95, they may delay contract. Let's prioritize infra readiness and quick evaluation so sales has something to show.

lina_cs: Uploading their validation CSV and vendor spec to CS-4891 now. I'll book a kickoff with MeadowBridge + vendor for Friday 10am CET.

legalbot: Calendar invite created and DPA checklist assigned to legal_team.
